B0.reason: Candidate 2 ships no M55 Candidate declaration and no value(a,b,ctx) natural-render pairwise entry point.

B1.reason: M55 supplies one pair of half-merges per MTF rung. Candidate 2 requires zero-target covariance plus separate symmetric derivative and held-out target ensembles for each system.

B2.reason: There is no Candidate 2 scalar value(a,b) to apply one-sided gain or swap to. Making dense/sparse the target classes is label-swap invariant and changes the estimand.

B3.reason: Nuisance leverage needs the same lawful comparative reading under alternate nuisance settings; no natural-output reading exists.

B4.reason: The measured no-target plant returned NUMERIC in every repeat (16/16) rather than rejecting the planted wrong answer.

B5.reason: Candidate 2 declares no M55 range/status contract, and its comparative ratio denominator is not bounded away from zero on no-target inputs.

B6.reason: Each held-out M55 cell provides a natural half-merge pair, not the target-labelled covariance/derivative/test streams Candidate 2 needs.

B7.reason: The M55 repetitions sweep cannot call Candidate 2 without inventing a target task and a pairwise adapter; null d2 is strictly positive and makes ratios unstable.

B8.reason: Candidate 2 has no M55 declaration of consumed calibration. Its synthetic generator supplies signal and noise constants, so perturbing them would audit that plant, not a natural image candidate.

B9.reason: M55's roll-null acts on value(a,b); Candidate 2 has no such reading and no registered spatial roll-null for its labelled observation ensembles.
